snippet.title: F*ck This Game - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794700/Fck_This_Game/

Official Steam release trailer for F*ck This Game, developed by helloitscrash and TabularElf.

F*ck This Game is a game that is extremely difficult. The premise may sound simple: use the keys on your keyboard to control small minigames, including a side-scrolling platformer and a shoot-em-up game. But here's the catch: you'll have to control up to 8 of these games at the same time.
Collect 2x score multipliers, avoid obstacles, and ignore the many, MANY distractions throughout that attempt to make you lose. How far are you willing to go until you scream: F*CK THIS GAME!

Website: https://helloitscrash.com/ftg
